title: Transcutaneous electrical acupoint stimulation for postoperative nausea and vomiting in patients undergoing craniotomy: A randomized controlled trial
source_read: Complete6-page source, visual Fig1 and Tables4–5; cited2013 protocol retrieved/read publisher.
comparator: Cut-wire no-current sham P6; both ondansetron8mg
population: Adults18–70 craniotomy GA; West China Hospital Oct2014–Sep2018.
rescue_regimen: Publication IM tramadol10mg forVAS>6, IM metoclopramide10mg for intolerable nausea/vomiting. Do not silently change10mg. Protocol instead describes postoperative IV fentanyl PCIA.
source_conflicts: Exclusion of motion-sickness history conflicts with Table2 positive history16/57 and16/58.
2013 five-arm protocol300 planned vs two-arm120 publication; protocol planned lost cases counted PONV, publication excluded5.
No cumulative0–24h vomiting total; intervals cannot be added as unique patients.
Rescue10mg IM tramadol unusual but printed twice; preserve pending clarification.
independence: Linked Lv2021 manual acupuncture report cites same protocol; TEAS/sham appear distinct protocol arms, but allocation framework/amendments and shared-control overlap unresolved. No automatic independent counting of linked reports.
